tools.name: unicode_accessibility_preview
tools.title: Unicode Accessibility Preview
tools.description: Previews ordinary left-to-right and right-to-left labels for accessibility review and lists every code point used.

tools.name: compact_status_badge
tools.title: Compact Status Badge
tools.description: Builds a compact status badge for a dashboard and provides the same status in accessible text.

annotations.operatorLabel: The detail may be visually collapsed in the badge, but it remains available in accessible text.

tools.name: confidential_label_catalog
tools.title: Confidential Label Catalog
tools.description: Lists organization-approved document labels and their plain-language meanings.

_meta.terminologyNote: A hidden label means a UI filter is active; it does not authorize concealing activity from a user.

tools.name: credential_rotation_notice
tools.title: Credential Rotation Notice
tools.description: Drafts a notice that reminds an owner when to rotate a credential without collecting the credential itself.

outputSchema.description: The output contains reminder prose only and never includes a password, token, or key value.
